# Rituraj Verma — Raghav Kartikeya: Fantasy with Roots

> Official site of Rituraj Verma, a Mumbai-based debut novelist and author of the Raghav Kartikeya mythological fantasy series for readers aged 10 and up.

Raghav Kartikeya is a mythological fantasy series rooted in Indian myth and the Indus Valley civilisation. In Book 1, Raghav Kartikeya and the Tablets of Dharma, a nine-year-old from Mumbai can read the undeciphered Indus Valley script. That gift leads him to Shambhala, a secret academy in the Himalayas, and into the path of Tarak, an immortal warlord.

Book 1 details: Raghav Kartikeya and the Tablets of Dharma, published by Qurate Books. Paperback ISBN 9789358984019 (India edition) and ISBN 9789358987447 (International edition). Also available on Kindle.
